params.triggerJumper: L = non-repeatable trigger, H = repeatable trigger

provenance.notes: KIT: no PIR lesson or part in the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit table of contents or Component List photo, so 'not in kit'. There is no single manufacturer datasheet; the numbers below come from the ElecFreaks-labelled 'Specification' PDF (2011-6-3, electronilab copy) and the other copies listed, which disagree in places. PIN ORDER: the SunFounder back-of-board drawing prints VCC, OUT, GND left to right along the pin edge; components101 lists pin 1 Vcc, 2 Dout, 3 Ground. Seen from the lens side the AZ-Delivery guide draws the same pins GND, OUT, VCC top to bottom. The header is male pins: the Rapid sheet's photo shows three bare pins standing out of the component side, and the AZ-Delivery guide's back photo shows the 3-pin header there. SUPPLY CONFLICT: the ElecFreaks sheet, the upc.edu copy and components101 say DC 4.5-20 V; the Rapid Online sheet, SunFounder and the second table of the upc.edu copy say 5-20 V; 4.5 V is used as the minimum. OUTPUT: high 3.3 V, low 0 V in every copy ('TTL output: 3.3V, 0V'), so the output is safe for a 3.3 V GPIO even when the module runs from 5 V. The module has a regulator on board (the AZ-Delivery guide describes bypassing it to run from 3.3 V by removing jumper J1 and feeding pin H; that mod is not modelled). QUIESCENT CURRENT: less than 50 uA (ElecFreaks, Rapid copy); Rapid and AZ-Delivery list 65 mA 'power consumption'. DELAY CONFLICT: the ElecFreaks spec table says 5-200 s, the same sheet's adjustment note says about 5 s to about 300 s, the upc.edu second table says 5-300 s (about 0.3 s to 5 min), SunFounder says 5-200 s; 5-200 s is used. BLOCK TIME CONFLICT: ElecFreaks, upc.edu and Rapid say 2.5 s by default (can be set from 0 s up to tens of seconds); SunFounder says 8 s; the AZ-Delivery guide says 2.5 s up to 10 s; 2.5 s is used. TRIGGER MODES: jumper L = non-repeatable trigger (output goes low after the delay even if there is motion), H = repeatable trigger (the delay restarts on each movement); ElecFreaks says the default is repeatable, components101 says repeatable is the default. The SunFounder back drawing labels the three-pin jumper block L at the top and H at the bottom with the shunt on one pair. TWO POTENTIOMETERS: delay adjustment and distance adjustment (SunFounder drawing; ElecFreaks 'Dimensions and Adjustment'): clockwise on the distance pot raises the sensing distance to about 7 m, anticlockwise lowers it to about 3 m; clockwise on the delay pot lengthens the delay (about 300 s per the note) and anticlockwise shortens it (about 5 s). START-UP: about one minute of initialisation after power-up during which the output can pulse 0-3 times (ElecFreaks, SunFounder). ANGLE CONFLICT: ElecFreaks table '<100 degree cone angle' (its range figure also shows 100 deg); the upc.edu table '<110 deg'; Rapid, SunFounder and components101 '<120 deg' or 'about 120 deg'; 100 deg is used. RANGE: within 7 m. TEMPERATURE: -15 to +70 C. SIZE: board 32 x 24 mm (ElecFreaks, Rapid, SunFounder), lens diameter 23 mm, screw spacing 28 mm for M2 (Rapid Online); the overall height, 24.7 mm, is one reseller's 'Height (with lens): 24.66mm' (nyehandel listing), which matches the photos: a 5 mm square lens base and an 11.5 mm dome (Murata's 23 mm PPGI0626 lens stands 16.5 mm) over a 1.6 mm board, and the capacitors and the jumper hanging about 6.5 mm under it. The AZ-Delivery guide's '33 x 25 x 30 mm' is larger than any of these and is not used; the 28 mm screw spacing and the lens height are not shown in the ElecFreaks sheet. LOOK: SunFounder's module photo (12_pir_module.png) and the AZ-Delivery guide show a dark blue board (older boards, as in the Rapid and Electrokit sheets, are green): on the lens side only the white Fresnel dome on its square base, the two M2 holes at the ends and the soldered leads; on the component side the two side-adjust trimmers with orange rotors facing out of a long edge, the H/L jumper with a yellow cap, the BISS0001, the 7133 regulator, a glass diode, four electrolytic capacitors and the passives, and the straight 3-pin header pointing away from the lens. bodyMm is 24 x 32 x 24.7 mm: the model runs the 32 mm along its y axis, so that the header row (x) fits on the lens side's free end, where the model stands it (ADR-0044: a female housing must reach the pins from above).
